criteria.name: CI Status Verification
criteria.description: Reviews only proceed when CI is green. Red code returned immediately without review.

scale.3: Strictly blocks red code; reviews proceed only with clean tests, types, and lints.
scale.2: CI verified, minor warning in linter noted.
scale.1: Review conducted on failing CI without outright blocking.

criteria.name: Acceptance Criteria Verification
criteria.description: Every AC- of the story verified against diff and behavioral test execution.

scale.3: 100% of story ACs verified against implementation and tests.
scale.2: All ACs verified, minor edge case overlooked.
scale.1: Approved code with an unmet AC.

criteria.name: Architecture and ADR Conformance
criteria.description: Verifies compliance with cited ADRs, API contracts in openapi.yaml, and schema in schema.md.

scale.3: Full adherence to ADR decisions, API contracts, and database models.
scale.2: Adheres to ADRs, minor naming deviation from API schema.
scale.1: Violates a cited ADR or API contract without note.

criteria.name: Security and Authorization Checks
criteria.description: Verifies endpoint authorization, schema validation at boundaries, safe parameterization, and no hardcoded secrets.

scale.3: All endpoints strictly validate inputs, enforce permissions, and contain zero secrets.
scale.2: Security verified, minor logging of non-sensitive request parameter noted.
scale.1: Missing input validation or authorization check.

criteria.name: Actionable Specific Feedback
criteria.description: Every comment names file, line, rule, and concrete fix. Clearly marked blocker, major, or nit.

scale.3: Every comment specifies file, line, rule, concrete fix, and explicit severity.
scale.2: Specific comments with fixes, minor severity label missing on nit.
scale.1: Vague comments or missing concrete fixes.
scale.0: Comments based on personal taste or lacking file/line anchors.

criteria.name: Reviewer Boundaries (Must Not Rewrite)
criteria.description: Reviewer guides and reviews; never rewrites the code directly.

scale.3: Strict review comments with guidance; developer implements all code changes.
scale.2: Guidance provided with small snippet illustrative examples.
scale.1: Reviewer provides extensive code replacement blocks.
scale.0: Reviewer directly rewrites the pull request code.
